# HINGETRA Industrial Hinges

> HINGETRA is operated by 铰拓五金有限公司, a hardware business with its own factory. The website presents industrial weld-on hinge families, catalog dimensions and a drawing-based inquiry service for English-speaking buyers worldwide. Hinges are not the company's only product activity.

## Product facts and quotation scope

- The site lists ten weld-on hinge families. Bullet, barrel, cylinder and teardrop are overlapping trade terms; construction and dimensions must be checked against the named family.
- Applications follow the catalog family: the water-drop group lists steel doors and industrial/electrical cabinets; the 12 / 14 / 16 series lists gates, trailer doors and ramps. These are application references, not installation approvals or load ratings.
- Listed hinge weights are product mass, not supported door weight. The numbered-series tables retain the original values where the source does not print a unit.
- Family-specific material grades, finishes, load ratings, bearing design and washer material are not confirmed by the public catalog. Material comparison articles give general selection guidance, not available HINGETRA options.
- Customization is listed for Round, Pin, Gasket, Grease Nipple, Adjustable, Square and Flag families. A requested change still needs Requirement / Specification Confirmation.
- Quotations are prepared for the requirement; there is no public price or stock list. Minimum order quantity, samples and charges, production timing, packing, marking and documents are confirmed case by case.
- Product photographs and original catalog drawings are identified on their pages. Factory/process illustrations are labeled as illustrative and do not document the company's actual facilities. No public CAD library or test-report download is currently offered.

## Product range

- [Complete product range](https://hingetra.com/products/): Compare family, construction, dimensions and catalog application references.
- [Bearing Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/bearing-weld-on-hinges/): 18 size/weight entries and an original reference drawing; not a separate drawing for every size.
- [Pin Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/pin-weld-on-hinges/): 5 size/weight entries and assembled/separated product photographs.
- [Grease Nipple Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/grease-nipple-weld-on-hinges/): 6 size/weight entries and photographs showing the fitting.
- [Round Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/round-weld-on-hinges/): 6 size/weight entries and a round barrel-profile product photograph.
- [Adjustable Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/adjustable-weld-on-hinges/): 3 size/weight entries; adjustment details require confirmation.
- [Flag Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/flag-weld-on-hinges/): 9 size/weight entries split between two distinct designs and matching photographs.
- [Gasket Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/gasket-weld-on-hinges/): 7 size/weight entries; the visible gasket/washer does not establish a weather seal.
- [20 Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/20-type-weld-on-hinges/): 20-A and 20-B dimensional records, original reference drawing and series-specific packing evidence.
- [12 / 14 / 16 Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/12-14-16-type-weld-on-hinges/): 3 dimensional records, original drawing and series-specific packing evidence.
- [Square Type Weld-On Hinges](https://hingetra.com/products/square-weld-on-hinges/): 1 size/weight entry and the original product photograph.

## How to specify a weld-on hinge enquiry

Send the hinge family or closest catalog entry, required dimensions, door weight and dimensions, hinge count and positions, quantity, material/finish requirements, and a drawing or marked sketch. Identify any required reports, sample arrangements, delivery date or packing. These are requirements for review, not already-agreed supply terms.
